name: SyncRanker – AI SEO Writer, Automatic Internal Linking, Redirects & SEO Migration
author: SyncRanker

sections.description:
SyncRanker is an AI-powered WordPress SEO plugin and content optimization toolkit for creating, rewriting, and optimizing SEO-friendly content. It combines AI content writing, automatic internal linking, on-page SEO analysis, redirects, XML sitemaps, SEO metadata, and 1-click SEO migration in one lightweight plugin.

Connect WordPress to SyncRanker Article Studio for AI article generation, existing-content rewriting, contextual internal-link injection, metadata optimization, batch scheduling, and automated publishing.

🆕 New in v3.4.0: 1-Click SEO Migration & SyncRanker Article Studio Integration

Move supported SEO metadata into SyncRanker with a streamlined 1-click migration workflow and real-time AJAX batch processing. Seamlessly migrate existing SEO titles, meta descriptions, focus keywords, and indexing settings from:
* Yoast SEO
* Rank Math
* All in One SEO (AIOSEO)
* SEOPress

AI SEO Writer & Article Studio

Connect WordPress to SyncRanker Article Studio for AI article generation, existing article rewriting, contextual internal-link injection, metadata optimization, batch scheduling, and publishing.

Automatic Internal Linking

SyncRanker discovers relevant existing content and creates contextual internal linking opportunities using semantic topics, categories, site content, and relevant anchor text.

On-Page SEO Analyzer

Includes a 12-point real-time SEO analyzer with:
* SEO scoring
* Title and meta description analysis
* Keyword and topic checks
* First-100-words analysis
* Table of contents detection
* Featured image alt-text verification
* SERP snippet preview

1-Click SEO Migration

Migrate supported SEO metadata directly into SyncRanker from four popular SEO plugins: Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO (AIOSEO), and SEOPress.

Redirect Manager

Manage your site’s traffic flow with precise URL and path tracking. Includes:
* 301 redirects
* 302 redirects
* 410 responses
* Automatic slug-change tracking

XML Sitemaps

A native XML sitemap generator providing a clean sitemap hierarchy accessible instantly at /sync-sitemap.xml. Includes XSL stylized presentation support.

SEO Metadata, Schema & Webmaster Verification

Manage SEO metadata, JSON-LD schema generation, and easily verify your site with Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, Baidu, Yandex, and Pinterest.

Lightweight WordPress SEO Tools

Built with strict WordPress coding standards, SyncRanker uses native PHP and standard WP queries to ensure optimal performance.

External Services

This plugin can optionally connect to SyncRanker cloud services:
* SyncRanker Platform: (https://syncranker.com) Used for account authentication, remote article publishing, and accessing web SEO utilities.

Terms of Service: https://syncranker.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://syncranker.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins -> Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for SyncRanker Connector or upload syncranker-connector.zip.
  3. Click Install Now and Activate.
  4. Go to Settings -> Permalinks and click Save Changes once to flush rewrite rules for /sync-sitemap.xml.
  5. (Optional) Go to SyncRanker in your sidebar to configure settings or connect your cloud workspace.
sections.faq:
Is SyncRanker an AI SEO plugin for WordPress?

Yes, SyncRanker combines AI content creation, article rewriting, internal linking, on-page SEO analysis, metadata tools, and other SEO utilities into a single WordPress plugin.

Can SyncRanker automatically add internal links?

Yes, SyncRanker provides automatic and contextual internal linking by analyzing semantic topics, categories, and site content to discover relevant internal linking opportunities.

Can I rewrite existing WordPress articles with AI?

Yes, through the SyncRanker Article Studio integration, you can perform AI article generation and existing article rewriting directly.

Can I migrate from another SEO plugin?

Yes, SyncRanker features a 4-in-1 migration tool. You can migrate supported metadata from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO (AIOSEO), and SEOPress in a single click.

Does SyncRanker generate XML sitemaps?

Yes, SyncRanker generates a clean XML sitemap hierarchy automatically accessible at /sync-sitemap.xml.

Does SyncRanker manage redirects?

Yes, it includes a robust Redirect Manager for 301, 302, and 410 redirects, alongside automatic slug-change tracking.

Is the local SEO analyzer and sitemap generator free?

Yes. The 12-point On-Page SEO Analyzer, Stylized XML Sitemaps, SERP Snippet Previewer, Schema Generator, and Dashboard Widget are free.

How do I submit my sitemap to Google Search Console?

Simply submit https://yourdomain.com/sync-sitemap.xml directly in your Google Search Console Sitemaps tab.
sections.changelog:
3.4.0

  • Major Feature: 4-in-1 Legacy SEO Migration Engine (Seamless 1-click batch import from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, and SEOPress).
  • Feature: On-Page SEO Distribution Hub & Studio Filter Endpoints for SyncRanker AI CMS (/studio/overview, /studio/posts).
  • Fix: Multi-engine Webmaster Verification meta tag rendering (Google, Bing msvalidate.01, Baidu, Yandex, Pinterest).
  • Performance: Optimized REST API routes for external Studio management and content synchronization.
  • Enhancement: Added 1:1 Redirect Manager with automated slug change tracking.
  • Compatibility: Fully tested and compatible up to WordPress 7.1.

3.3.2

  • Feature: Added built-in Redirect Manager (301, 302, 410) with automatic slug-change tracking.
  • Feature: Added visual SEO Score color indicators (Red, Orange, Green, SyncRanker Blue) to Post list columns and Top Admin Bar.
  • Fix: Resolved minor frontend/backend context switching logic for the admin bar SEO score.
  • Tweak: Extensive WordPress Coding Standards (WPCS) code sanitization and security hardening.

3.3.1

  • Enhancement: Implemented smart 3-tier “Waterfall” fallback algorithm in REST API for contextual internal link discovery.
  • Enhancement: Tier 1 matches semantic focus keywords/topics, Tier 2 fills gaps via shared category taxonomy, and Tier 3 utilizes fresh site-wide content.
  • Performance: Guaranteed strict post deduplication and current post ID exclusion across all internal linking queries.
  • Optimization: Added intelligent edge-case detection (isNewSite flag & post count threshold) to support clean AI content publishing on new WordPress sites.
  • Tested: Fully validated for WordPress REST API high-concurrency standards and SEO link architecture.

3.3.0

  • Major Release: Upgraded to 12-point real-time On-Page SEO scoring engine.
  • Added native Stylized XML Sitemap index engine (/sync-sitemap.xml) with XSL stylesheet support.
  • Added intelligent entity and morphological keyword matching in first 100 words.
  • Added Table of Contents detection and AI transitional filler scrubber.
  • Added featured image alt-text verification in SEO checklist.
  • Added on-demand REST endpoints for topic uniqueness and contextual internal link discovery.
  • 100% WordPress VIP and Plugin Check (PCP) security and performance compliance.

3.2.0

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org.
